new.name: CVE-2026-121716
new.description: fzf <=0.74.4: bin/fzf-tmux validated size values only for the separate-argument form — the attached form (-l50) reached bash arithmetic unvalidated, so an operand like a[$(cmd)] executes during option parsing, even outside tmux. Verbatim fzf-tmux 0.74.4 vs 0.74.5 (f126ff29): payload executed on vuln, validation regex rejects on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-129303
new.description: guard-core 1.0.0-3.12.0: enhanced-mode preprocessing collapsed whitespace before matching, erasing \r/\n and making the newline-based http_split and cmd_injection detectors structurally unmatchable (split-request + shell detections dead). Verbatim preprocessor.py 3.12.0 vs 3.13.0: detectors dead on vuln, matching on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-129304
new.description: guard-core 1.0.0-3.12.0: _extract_from_forwarded_header returned the selected XFF entry with no ipaddress validation — an attacker entry (*, evil[?]) becomes client_ip and BehaviorTracker interpolates it into a Redis KEYS glob. Verbatim v3.12.0 function vs v3.13.0 ip_extraction: metachar accepted on vuln, refused + benign canonicalized on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-129302
new.description: guard-core 3.5.0-3.12.0: built-in detection patterns ran as bare inline pattern.search on the asyncio loop with no timeout — the template-injection detector costs O(N^2) on a '{'-run body, freezing every endpoint, repeatable indefinitely. Verbatim pattern + verbatim safe matcher 3.13.0 (c07239fa): 13.7 s bare vs timeout-refused on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-130007
new.description: k8s-mcp-server <1.1.0: the default SSE transport dispatched MCP tools/call with no authentication or Origin check — any client reaching the port invokes the server's Kubernetes tools with cluster privileges. Real server v1.0.12 vs v1.1.0 (817d8100): tools/list dispatched without credentials on vuln, loopback + fail-closed bearer on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-129307
new.description: eml_parser <=3.0.3: routing.parserouting built a regex from four greedy .* groups terminated by an escaped date literal from the NORMALIZED header — searched in the ORIGINAL line, a crafted header drives exhaustive 4-group backtracking: O(n^4), one ~5.9 KB email pins a core ~10 min. Verbatim 3.0.3 vs 3.0.4 (54ea6e9f): 590 s vs 0.001 s.

new.name: CVE-2026-129230
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: the WordNet Synset hypernym walkers recursed through the hypernym graph with no visited set and no depth cap — a cyclic or over-deep crafted data.<pos> graph raises an uncaught RecursionError. Verbatim wordnet.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: RecursionError on 8/8 walker runs on vuln, cycle/depth-256 ValueErrors on fixed (34adf1ee).

new.name: CVE-2026-129228
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: Toolbox settings-tree helpers recursed per element level with no counter and the parse producer builds unbounded nesting — a deeply nested settings file crashes to_settings_string with an uncaught RecursionError. Verbatim toolbox.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4 (0b697537): depth 2000 crashes vuln, bounded ValueError at 500 on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-129226
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: the semantic-logic type parser read_type recursed on both halves of every <a,b> with no depth bound — MAX_PARSE_DEPTH never ran on that path, so nested type strings via Type.fromstring raise an uncaught RecursionError. Verbatim logic.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4 (2f4f0d47): crash at 3000 on vuln, bounded at 200 on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-129225
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: DependencyGraph traversal helpers (_tree/triples/get_cycle_path) recursed once per dependency link with no depth bound — a 2000-link chain raises an unhandled RecursionError in tree(). Verbatim dependencygraph.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: RecursionError on vuln, bounded ValueError MAX_DEPTH=200 on fixed (a7468275).

new.name: CVE-2026-129232
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: XMLCorpusView.read_block re-joined the root-to-node path on every start tag — O(depth) each, unbounded nesting costs O(n^2) CPU while iterating an attacker XML file. Verbatim xmldocs.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: a 20000-deep file burns ~1.5 s on vuln, bounded ValueError past MAX_XML_DEPTH=500 on fixed (002bcf71).

new.name: CVE-2026-129231
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: SeekableUnicodeStreamReader.readline re-ran splitlines over the whole growing buffer per 8000-char block — one unterminated line of N chars costs O(N^2) CPU through the default size=None corpus path. Verbatim data.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: a single 8M-char line burns ~3 s on vuln, 0.012 s linear on fixed (002bcf71).

new.name: CVE-2026-129233
new.description: NLTK 3.10.0-3.10.3: StreamBackedCorpusView.__init__ stat'ed a raw fileid without pathsec containment — an out-of-root file's existence and exact size leak to the constructor caller. Verbatim util.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: out-of-root eofpos=1337 disclosed on vuln, validate_path-first (never stat'ed) on fixed (2c563b13).

new.name: cve-2026-99312-audit
new.description: Read-only audit for CVE-2026-99312: Linux KVM nested SVM flaw on AMD hosts (guest to host memory access). POSIX sh, no root needed.

new.name: CVE-2026-129234
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: config_prover9 accepted a relative binary_location — find_binary resolved it against the CWD (bare-alternative match yields a planted ./prover9) and subprocess.Popen executed it: local arbitrary code execution. Verbatim internals+prover9 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: planted binary executed on vuln, CWD-relative refused on fixed (4ca190b7).

new.name: CVE-2026-129224
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: the CCG lexicon parser recursed per nested bracket with no depth bound — adversarially deep categories raise an unhandled RecursionError through the public fromstring entry. Verbatim lexicon.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: depth 3000 RecursionError on vuln, bounded ValueError at MAX_PARSE_DEPTH=500 on fixed (30e93eb7).

new.name: CVE-2026-129227
new.description: NLTK <=3.10.3: Tree.fromlist recursed without a depth bound (the fromstring MAX_TREE_DEPTH cap was never applied) — adversarially deep nested lists raise an unhandled RecursionError in parsing pipelines. Verbatim tree.py 3.10.3 vs 3.10.4: depth 3000 RecursionError on vuln, bounded ValueError at MAX_TREE_DEPTH=500 on fixed (ae4c5c90).

new.name: CVE-2026-58208
new.description: nats-server <2.14.3: the WebSocket listener routed /mqtt upgrades into MQTT handling even with MQTT disabled — an unauthenticated client reached uninitialized MQTT state and crashed the process. Real server from tags: wss /mqtt upgrade + CONNECT kills the process on 2.14.2, 404 on 2.14.3 (73b3dd9a).

new.name: CVE-2026-58209
new.description: nats-server <2.14.3: MQTT retained delivery and QoS1+ durable replay skipped the subscribe deny check — a wildcard-allowed subscriber received denied topics (live delivery correctly blocked them). Real server from tags, driven with paho-mqtt across all three paths: bypass on 2.14.2, checkDenySub recheck on 2.14.3 (181b1f51).
